purpose: Design of the agenda display layer (agenda_render.py): HTML generation, state and change highlighting, severity badges, auto-reload update scheme, and initial open trigger.
summary: Why HTML is adopted and how the first display is opened via the open command
Template structure: summary table, item cards, dl labels, anchor links
Change indication via gutter dot and field-level data-changed attributes
Severity shown as pastel color plus text label, via config.severity_field
CSS selector targets, with concrete values left to be tuned after implementation
State column derived from background, essence, and decision without a status field
Auto-follow update: agenda_state.js polling and full reload on content_version change
Scroll position preserved with sessionStorage across reloads
Test design and manual verification points
Existing components reused: discussion template and HTML escape pattern
